tasks.title: Host verified Local App template catalog read surface
tasks.gate: §9.4.1 / §18 Phase 3: the Host catalog returns only available semantic template fields plus catalog_digest and never exposes family, revision, path, or asset hashes

plantedFailure.edit: add family, revision, path, or inventory hash to the Host catalog response

tasks.notes: The catalog is connection/session-scoped and read-only. Its semantic response intentionally omits Host authority; downstream validation re-reads the verified catalog.

tasks.title: Template-selector-only validation and anti-stale selection
tasks.gate: §9.4.1 / §9.5: only template-selector can validate a proposal; Host re-reads catalog digest and returns a display-only rejected list plus an opaque validated_selection_handle

plantedFailure.edit: accept a catalog-stale, catalog-external, or caller-supplied family/path selection

tasks.notes: The handle is Host-issued and never derived from template_id, app_id, or a path. Agent output can echo catalog_digest only as an optimistic-concurrency token.

tasks.title: Durable run-scoped candidate journal and handle binding
tasks.gate: §9.5 / §16.3 / §18 Phase 3: candidate journal records app_id + workflow_run_id + catalog identity and rejects forged, cross-app, cross-run, stale, and missing handles

plantedFailure.edit: resolve a validated selection without checking its app_id or workflow_run_id journal binding

tasks.notes: Journal persistence is durable and run-scoped; it is not an additional global registry or a lease. No final receipt, Manifest, publish, or active catalog is created in this phase.

tasks.title: Create-only isolated staging and dependency input digest
tasks.gate: §9.5 / §10.1 / §18 Phase 3: create can stage from Host-issued selection before Manifest/Profile persistence, while update/verify require persisted Profile and dependency_input_sha256 covers requested/effective/base-lock inputs

plantedFailure.edit: write create source into the formal App workspace or let update infer a profile from caller args

tasks.notes: This phase stops at staging/evidence. The installed lock/tree/SBOM snapshot, receipt consumption, atomic scaffold commit, and publish remain later-phase work.
